title: Pump vibration analysis
requirement_text: Vibration analysis of each pump shall be recorded at least every 90 days.

title: Motor vibration analysis
requirement_text: Vibration analysis of each motor shall be recorded at least every 90 days.

title: Motor insulation test
requirement_text: Winding insulation resistance of each motor shall be tested every 180 days.

title: Boiler safety inspection
requirement_text: Each boiler shall have a documented safety inspection every 180 days.

title: Relief valve test
requirement_text: Pressure relief valves on boilers and compressors shall be tested every 365 days.

title: Compressor oil analysis
requirement_text: Compressor oil shall be analysed every 120 days.

title: Failed inspection follow-up
requirement_text: A failed inspection shall be followed by a work order within 14 days.

title: Lockout procedure documented
requirement_text: A documented lockout/tagout procedure shall exist before motor inspection.

title: Boiler water treatment documented
requirement_text: A boiler water treatment procedure shall be documented.
